subject: Physics
title: Current Electricity
summary: Current = charge ka flow. Wire mein electrons ka asli 'drift' bahut dheema hota hai (mm/s), lekin electric field poore circuit mein turant set ho jaati hai — isliye bulb switch dabate hi jalta hai.
Resistance material (resistivity ρ), length aur area par depend karta hai: R = ρL/A. Metals garam hone par zyada resist karte hain; semiconductors kam.
Har circuit sawal do niyamon se solve hota hai: Kirchhoff junction rule (charge conservation) aur loop rule (energy conservation). Series/parallel unhi ka shortcut hai.
Real cell ki internal resistance hoti hai, isliye current chalte waqt terminal voltage emf se kam hota hai. Bridges (Wheatstone, meter bridge) balance point se resistance naapte hain.

formulas.name: Current and drift speed
formulas.formula: I = dq/dt = n e A v_d
formulas.when: Wire mein current ko electrons ki speed se jodna.

formulas.name: Ohm's law and resistance
formulas.formula: V = I R,   R = ρ L / A
formulas.mistake: Wire stretch karo (volume same) to R ∝ L² — sirf L nahi.

formulas.name: Resistivity and temperature
formulas.when: Metal ka resistance temperature ke saath.
formulas.mistake: Semiconductor ke liye α negative hota hai.

formulas.name: Series and parallel
formulas.mistake: Parallel ka equivalent hamesha sabse chhote resistor se bhi chhota.

formulas.name: Real cell
formulas.formula: V = E − I r   (discharging),   I = E / (R + r)

formulas.name: Cells in series and parallel
formulas.formula: Series: E = E₁ + E₂, r = r₁ + r₂.   Parallel: E = (E₁r₂ + E₂r₁)/(r₁ + r₂), r = r₁r₂/(r₁ + r₂)

formulas.name: Electric power
formulas.formula: P = V I = I² R = V² / R
formulas.mistake: Series mein same I ⇒ zyada R zyada garam; parallel mein same V ⇒ kam R zyada garam.

formulas.name: Kirchhoff's rules
formulas.mistake: Loop mein sign convention pehle tay karo aur usi par tike raho.

formulas.name: Wheatstone and meter bridge
formulas.formula: Balance: P/Q = R/S.   Meter bridge: R/S = l / (100 − l)

examples.title: Electrons kitne dheeme?
examples.problem: Copper wire: A = 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ m², I = 1.5 A, n = 8.5 × 10²⁸ m⁻³. Drift speed?

examples.title: Cell ka terminal voltage
examples.problem: E = 12 V, r = 0.4 Ω ka cell 5.6 Ω resistor se juda hai. Current aur terminal voltage?

examples.title: Meter bridge
examples.problem: Right gap mein S = 30 Ω; balance point left end se 40 cm par. Left gap ka R?

topics.title: Drift vs thermal motion
topics.explain: Electrons bina field ke bhi tez (random) bhaagte hain, par net flow zero. Field lagne par chhota sa average drift banta hai — wahi current hai.

topics.title: Ohmic aur non-ohmic
topics.explain: Metal wire (constant temperature) V-I graph seedhi line. Diode, garam hota filament non-ohmic — wahan R = V/I har point par alag.

topics.title: Temperature ka asar
topics.explain: Metal: temperature badhe ⇒ atoms zyada vibrate ⇒ collisions zyada ⇒ ρ badhta hai. Semiconductor: zyada charge carriers free ⇒ ρ ghatta hai.

topics.title: Internal resistance
topics.explain: Cell ke andar bhi current ko rukawat milti hai (r). Isliye short circuit current E/r se zyada nahi ho sakta.

topics.title: Bridges
topics.explain: Wheatstone balance par galvanometer mein current zero, isliye uski resistance answer par asar nahi daalti. Meter bridge mein balance point beech ke paas ho to error kam.

ratta: Colour code 0–9: Black, Brown, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Violet, Grey, White — "BB ROY of Great Britain had a Very Good Wife".

Resistivity: silver < copper < aluminium (silver sabse kam).
